theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U B K : Set (Euclid P)) (hBU : B ⊆ U) (F : GeometricCurrentOn U m), IsOpen B → IsCompact K → K ⊆ B → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U m, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m)) K → F ω = 0) → (∀ ψ : TestFormOn B m, F (testFormOnInclusion hBU m ψ) = 0) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U m, F ω = 0
